body:
A) Free feed bucket at the farm (my pick)
B) Feed from the Market, 5 coins
Game rules say anyone can feed and pet farm animals any time. Nobody owns them, so nothing to earn back.
A) keeps the farm a free, friendly place, like the Tree park.
